map.一根毛发能个体识别吗？: Can a single hair identify an individual?
map.不能。形态只能定种属与部位，个体识别需 mtDNA/核 DNA 分型；毛干无根时: No. Morphology can only determine species and body site; individual identification requires mtDNA/nuclear DNA typing, and when the shaft has no root there is little nuclear DNA, so mitochondrial DNA is usually used.
map.漂白/染发影响鉴别吗？: Does bleaching or dyeing affect identification?
map.会改变色素与表面，但髓质形态与鳞片结构稳定，仍可鉴别；受损（断端、化学处理）需结: It changes pigment and surface, but medulla morphology and scale structure remain stable so identification is still possible; damaged hair (broken ends, chemical treatment) needs to be combined with cross-section features.
